reproducibility_gaps: The Conda manifest is extensive and largely pinned, but several pip dependencies including torch, torchvision, torchaudio, ptflops and pyyaml are not version-pinned.
The 16-Hz Gabor command in scripts/run.sh does not explicitly set a seed, unlike the other documented 4-Hz and 16-Hz commands.
scripts/run.sh requires user replacement of absolute tb_root, run_root and data_root placeholders before execution.

README hardware provenance describes a single NVIDIA GeForce A6000 GPU, while scripts/run.sh explicitly dispatches concurrent configurations across cuda:0 through cuda:3; the source-scoped inconsistency is preserved rather than reconciled.
notes: R3 reflects an explicit installation procedure, pinned environment surface, six exact training commands, seeds for five of six commands, hardware documentation and evaluation instructions; the remaining static gaps and device-provenance conflict prevent R4.
